notes: Brown rice weighed raw at 200 g a 250 ml cup; tinned sugar beans 240 g drained per tin, valued as boiled cranberry beans like the rest of the catalogue; potatoes at the recipe's 300 g peeled; all 2 tbsp oil eaten; cinnamon stick lifted out. Rice is about 185 kcal and the kachumbar about 35 kcal of each serving, so the curry alone is about 340. Sanity check (published figures as recalled; web search was unavailable): bean curries without rice run 250–330 kcal a serving (Durban-style sugar bean curry recipes with 2 tins for 4, 1–3 tbsp oil; vegan bean-and-potato curries 280–320 kcal); adding ¼ cup raw brown rice (~185 kcal) and a raw salad puts comparable plates at 470–550 kcal, so ours at 560 sits at the top of that range because of the potato and the full 2 tbsp oil.
